body_markdown:
Made for side quests, little adventures, and everything in between, the Designed for XBOX Cozy Collection is[available now](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/accessories#cozycollection) , bringing warmth and whimsy to every journey.


Step into a tiny, pixelated woodland where every click, key stroke, and button tap feels like discovering a new cozy corner. The 8BitDo keyboard, mouse, and controller bring a little wonder to every quest, with playful details that make your setup feel warm and cozy to its core.


Complete your quest with SteelSeries Arctis earbuds in Matcha and Yuzu, made to match the collection’s playful palette while soundtracking every adventure. Pair them with KontrolFreek thumbsticks for a fresh pop of color.


**8BitDo Retro 87 Mechanical Keyboard – Forest Wonder**


With an independent control panel, RGB backlight, programmable super buttons, and Kailh tactile switches, immerse yourself further in every adventure. Available now at[8bitdo.com](https://www.8bitdo.com/forest-wonder-keyboard-mouse-set) .


**8BitDo Retro R8 Mouse – Forest Wonder**


Stay on theme with the matching 8BitDo mouse and charging dock. The Retro R8 mouse and Retro keyboard share a unified design language, creating a cohesive and stylish setup. Designed for fast precision at your fingertips and four programmable side buttons, this mouse provides a tailored experience for your questing needs. Available now at[8bitdo.com](https://www.8bitdo.com/forest-wonder-keyboard-mouse-set) .


**8BitDo Ultimate 3 Controller – Mossy Lagoon**


Dive in with a palette drawn from water, moss, and tiny friends. The Ultimate 3 Controller features an improved grip for enhanced comfort, a wireless charging dock, and adjustable joystick tension. It supports 2.4G wireless and wired connections for XBOX, PC, and Bluetooth connectivity for mobile devices. Available now at[8bitdo.com](https://www.8bitdo.com/ultimate-3-xbox-mossy-lagoon) .


**SteelSeries Arctis Gamebuds – Matcha and Yuzu**


Complete your quest with the SteelSeries Arctis earbuds in Matcha and Yuzu so you can play anywhere with high-quality sound and ultra-low latency wireless connection. These earbuds feature Active Noise Cancellation, Quick-Switch 2.4GHz wireless & Bluetooth 5.3, and over 200 audio presets for XBOX and more on the Arctis Companion App. Enjoy immersive 360° Spatial Audio, 40 hours of total battery life with 10 hours of battery life per charge, and IP55 water/dust resistance all in a compact, Qi wireless-charging case. Available now at[Steelseries.com](https://steelseries.com/gaming-in-ear-headsets/arctis-gamebuds?color=matcha&primaryPlatform=xbox) .


**KontrolFreek No-Slip Thumb Grips – XBOX Cozy Edition**


Cozy gaming calls for a cozy setup. Curl up with No-Slip Thumb Grips – XBOX Cozy Edition, featuring a calming matcha and yuzu color combo to spruce up your XBOX controller. Proprietary, non-slip GripTek material helps keeps your thumbs in place for non-stop control—whether you’re farming, questing, or building your own utopia. And with an ergonomic design, you’ll stay comfortable all session long. Available now at[kontrolfreek.com](https://www.kontrolfreek.com/)


Whether you’re wandering through enchanted forests or tending to a garden, the Designed for XBOX Cozy Collection brings comfort and playful style to every adventure. Explore the full collection and make your setup feel a little more magical at[XBOX.com](https://www.xbox.com/en-US/accessories#cozycollection) .
